topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes, learning objectives, and conceptual framework for understanding cancer through evolutionary and microenvironmental mechanisms.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how driver mutations and epigenetic chromatin alterations confer selective growth advantages to cells during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchy, stemness properties, and the specific cell of origin determine malignant transformation and tumor propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Inflammatory Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental exposures and chronic inflammation act as promotional stimuli to induce stem-like states and drive tumorigenesis in mutated cells.

topics.label: Established Tumor Microenvironment and Spatial Profiling Methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the dependence of established tumors on supportive stromal environments and the modern spatial technologies used to analyze these interactions.

topics.label: Integrated Synthesis of Cancer Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture by integrating genetics, epigenetics, cell of origin, and microenvironmental coevolution into a comprehensive model of cancer development.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides a preview of the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
